description: 象腾挪b7，威胁后的同时清开斜线
explanation_en: The bishop moves to b7, attacks the queen, and clears its former diagonal.

intro.popup: 💡 腾挪：白象在e4。象跳到b7，能攻击黑后a6同时发挥更大价值吗？
intro.popup_en: 💡 Clearance: White's bishop is on e4. Can it move to b7 to attack Black's queen on a6 and become more active?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Bb7！象腾挪攻击Qa6——黑方Kxh6应对，Bxa6赢后！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Bb7! The bishop clears its diagonal while attacking Qa6. After ...Kxh6, Bxa6 wins the queen.

moves.popup: 白象Bb7！腾挪到b7，直接攻击黑后a6——后被迫应对或逃跑！
moves.popup_en: Bb7! The bishop clears its former diagonal and attacks Black's queen on a6, forcing it to respond or move.

moves.popup: 黑王Kxh6——吃白车，但黑后a6无法守！
moves.popup_en: The black king captures the rook on h6, but the queen on a6 cannot be saved.

moves.popup: 白象Bxa6！赢得黑后——腾挪战术完成！
moves.popup_en: Bxa6! White wins the black queen. The clearance tactic is complete.
